title: The Hidden Evil
author: Unknown
description: The Hidden Evil by Mark M. Rich (version 2.0g, last updated 5 May 2006), a self-published account from Malden, Massachusetts, describing what the author calls organised stalking or 'gang stalking'. Rich asserts that networks of citizens, community groups and agencies covertly harass targeted individuals through surveillance, noise campaigns, street theatre, workplace mobbing, break-ins and the use of electronic devices, and he traces the alleged practice to historical precedents such as COINTELPRO and the Stasi. The book offers his description of tactics, his explanations of motives, accounts from people who believe themselves targeted, and suggestions for coping and documentation. Its claims are not supported by independent evidence; it is best read as a primary document of the 'targeted individual' phenomenon.
